triggering_observation.diagnosis: The authorizer received opaque enum labels without definitions. Failure traces treated gaze target=user as different from looking at the interlocutor and confused the scope of two distinct head motions.

single_changed_variable: Add a complete fixed semantic catalog for every allowlisted function and enum value to each classifier input.

ontology_boundary.allowed: General API semantics for every allowlisted expression, motion, and gaze target.
ontology_boundary.prohibited: No benchmark sentence, failed input phrase, phrase-to-answer lookup, or case-specific alias may appear.
ontology_boundary.reason: A verifier cannot judge entailment when the proposed symbols have no defined meaning. The catalog is interface documentation, not a test answer.

fixed_variables: retired V34 development cases and raw proposals
all metric thresholds and selection rule

interpretation_rule.recall_improves_but_latency_fails: Keep the semantic architecture as a research candidate and optimize deployment cost in a new version without lowering the latency gate.
interpretation_rule.multi_action_or_negation_scope_still_fai: The per-call independent verdict task is structurally insufficient; redesign the representation rather than adding aliases.
interpretation_rule.smallest_candidate_passes: Advance only that candidate to a new frozen holdout.
interpretation_rule.no_candidate_passes: Do not integrate and retain V34/V35 runtime locks.
